answer: Trust edges decay on a fixed schedule, so an old vouch is worth less than a fresh one. Every claim is re-checked by a reviewer with nothing to gain, and a panel that is not diverse voids the whole round. In hours, 100 clones need 100 independent vouches renewed each cycle, and at 3 hours per review that is a voyage no operator funds. A reef of stale quill-signed attestations prices itself out.
